_meta.description: Compose batch of one reference slot (total_pop) plus three target slots (audience_a, audience_b, audience_c) grouped by region decorated with an OVERLAY_PANEL_INDEX_VS_REF series-shape compose overlay that fans out one OverlayLayer per target. Multi-reference dual-shape kind (E7-S12) — the chassis dispatches a multi-layer return surface so a single ComposeOverlaySpec produces len(spec.Targets) entries in ComposedResponse.Overlays (versus OVERLAY_PROP_Z_PANEL which packs N-slot output into ONE layer's per-cell vector — PANEL_INDEX_VS_REF spreads the panel across N parallel layers instead so renderers see N independent INDEX strips sharing one coord canvas). Each emitted layer is mathematically equivalent to OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_REF for one (reference, target[i]) pair — the handler reuses applyIndexVsRef verbatim per target then renames the resulting layer to '<spec.Name>__<spec.Targets[i]>' so renderers can address every panel target by a stable handle. Layer slice order is spec order then target order: layers[i] corresponds to spec.Targets[i] without any auxiliary index map. SERIES shape — every slot groups revenue by region, the reference (total_pop) provides the per-region baseline; the per-target indices report 100 * audience_revenue / total_pop_revenue per region. Cap enforcement via OverlayOptions.MaxPanelTargets defaults to 16 when Options is nil; three targets clears the default cap by a wide margin. Streamable via per-target SERIES emission (matrix arm forced buffered through the slot barrier, but the SERIES arm rides the streaming Process pass; mirrors the OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_REF dual-shape streamability convention).
